text:
35. If any person― General 2[Penalty which may

(a) forges or fraudulently alters any extend to two lakh

certificate of discharge or a certificate rupees.]
as to the work of a seaman or a
continuous discharge certificate or a
copy of any such certificate; or

(b) fraudulently uses any certificate of

discharge or a certificate as to the work
of a seaman or a continuous discharge
certificate or a copy of any such
certificate which is forged or altered or
does not belong to him.
